name: Amy Deng
bio: I'm Amy Deng, currently a grade 11 student. I have a passion for drawing and playing piano, and I also serve as one of the directors of NYS. I aim to leverage my energy and skills to enhance NYS as an organization. My motto is to "Embrace challenges, pursue excellence."

name: James Yin
bio: Hi, my name is James. I currently attend grade 11, and I have been a member of NYS since 2022. As the Vice President, I hope to bring out everybody's diverse talents and utilize them for the betterment of our collective community. Some of my interests include business, finance, and music. I look forward to working with you all!

name: Micah Hou
bio: I am Micah Hou, a grade 10 member of NYS. Serving as the President of EPS's 3D Printing Club and as one of the designers in revamping EPS's website, I aim to provide technical support to NYS in our events as well as maintaining and improving NYS's website and other technical infrastructure. This year as IT Director my goal is to migrate our website onto cloud hosting services under our own domain. It's going to be a exciting year, stay tuned!

name: Jimin Pei
bio: Hi, I'm Jimin Pei, a Grade 10 student at Elgin Park Secondary. I enjoy playing tennis, musical instruments, and collecting various items. I've been part of NYS for over two years and currently serve as Treasurer. I hope to use my time and skills to support NYS and help make it an even better organization behind the scenes. Looking forward to seeing you all this year!

name: Yuki Shi
bio: I'm Yuki Shi, a grade 9 student from GHS. I have been a member of NYS since 2023. I enjoy dancing and playing the piano. I will utilize my abilities and tap into my potential, hoping to grow together with NYS and form a bigger family.

name: Hanqing
bio: I'm Hanqing, and I am currently a grade 10 student at Grandview Heights Secondary. I have been a member of NYS since 2021, and I'm passionate about creativity and sharing the work we do here. I enjoy dancing and playing the piano, and I'm always open to learning and trying new ideas. My goal is to help make our events stand out through clear and engaging content now that I have been selected for the Media Officer role. I am excited to build onto my goals and support my members throughout this new journey.

name: Sophie Liu
bio: Hi, my name is Sophie Liu and I am a grade 11 IB student at Semiahmoo Secondary. I am honoured to take on the role of VP for public relations for NYS this year. As someone who loves turning ideas into action, I am extremely excited to coordinate projects that can make genuine impact across our community. Outside of school, I enjoy Latin dancing and reading, as well as spending time with my sister.
